name: webmcp-controller
description: Firefox MCP: WebExtension + native messaging host that serves MCP over HTTP to any harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @webmcp-controller/shared && npm run build -w @webmcp-controller/mcp-server
scripts.install-host: npm run build && node mcp-server/dist/host.js install
scripts.test: node test/e2e.mjs && MISSING=1 node test/e2e.mjs && node test/host.mjs && node test/content.mjs && node test/options.mjs
